resources.string: MS Screen Reader provides spoken feedback so that you can use your device without looking at the screen. MS Screen Reader can be helpful for people who have difficulty seeing the screen.

How to use MS Screen Reader
• Swipe right or left to move between items
• Double-tap to activate an item
• Drag two fingers to scroll

How to turn off MS Screen Reader
1. In Settings, tap Use MS Screen Reader. There will be an outline. Double-tap it.
2. On the confirmation message, tap Stop. There will be an outline. Double-tap it.
